resources.string: Built for privacy and trust. Zero trackers, zero hidden permissions, and zero data collection. Your login stays strictly between your device and Spotify/Google.
Know someone who needs a website or custom software? Earn 10% on every closed project.
Enjoy on-demand songs, unlimited skips, mobile-native layout, inertia auto-reload ad skipping, and screen-off playback—crafted by Studio Mogli.
Sign-in happens directly on Spotify\'s or Google\'s official login page. Studio Mogli never sees, touches, or stores your email or password.
2. Why We Technically Cannot Collect Your Data

This app has zero backend servers, zero analytics SDKs, and zero ad trackers. It only requests Internet and Notification permissions needed to play audio—no contacts, storage, camera, or location access.
Press the power button or switch apps anytime and music keeps playing. Tap Library in the top bar anytime to open your playlists. (Tip: Set Battery to Unrestricted in App Info.)
